flags: No operator or official page: nothing from the Lewistown Kiwanis Club, the City of Lewistown or Fergus County was found (searched 2026-10-22); website and phone are empty. Inclusion rests on Campendium and RV Life listings (latest reviews 2025). Presence rule: a human should check Google Maps (open, 25+ reviews, phone).

Ownership class: the listings describe a park 'owned & operated by local Kiwanis Club' (a private service club), not a town or county; 'local' may be wrong (private?), which also matters because the town/county exemption from the presence rule would not apply.
Aggregator data conflict: Campendium says 8 dry sites on grass, another listing 20; address 80335 vs 80397 US-87 (milepost 80.3, next to the airport, ~1 mi SW of town).
